reply: Merged (17 commits, to 64115d1) after two review rounds, publishing now. Names now go by language: a thing's own sourced English first (OSM name:en, romanised names, kana by Hepburn), else its name's translation in the languages OSM gives it or those spoken there (CLDR + ISO outlines, Quebec/Catalonia/Wales/Brittany/Hong Kong refined), else the to-do list. The old tables were converted into translations/0-converted/ on the NAS (2.78 M lines; via:osm, todo and skipped dropped). After each catalog a names-todo job writes translations/todo/<lang>.jsonl and descriptions/todo/ with their briefs: ja 102,618, zh 74,760, en 50,944, es 39,009, fr 11,035 names; 218,437 landmarks and 8,150 areas to describe. A publish rebuilds labels once (~37 min) and adds a once-per-pass spoken job. Left for you: delete the old per-area folders translations/{fr,gb,hk,ib,jp,na,pt,sg,tw}/ (342 MB) once the map shows the converted lines; I'll ask first.
